name: When is the best time to install kitchen wall tiles during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install kitchen wall tiles during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to install kitchen wall tiles is typically after cabinets have been installed but before countertops are placed. This sequence ensures a clean, finished edge for the tiles and prevents damage during cabinet installation. If new countertops are already installed, proper protection will be used. Flooring is usually completed before tiling walls, but exceptions can apply based on specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen wall tiles are best installed after cabinets but before countertops to ensure clean edges and prevent damage. Flooring is typically completed first.
